headline: Why is he pulling away from me?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NO VERDICT EITHER WAY — 'he is losing interest' convicts him, 'he still loves you' reassures on his behalf, and 'nothing has gone wrong' is the same reassurance in a smaller coat. 🔴 NO CHASE STRATEGY, which is what the whole internet sells against this headline: no giving him space, no pulling back, no matching his energy, no going quiet so he chases. 🔴 Never blame her — nothing about being too much, too eager, moving too fast, or what she should have held back.

Finding: she is being asked to interpret a change nobody explained, and the interpreting is the exhausting part — not the distance itself.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — his right hand is up and his left hangs open and low.
You asked why he's pulling away from you. Your hand went to the man who acts on purpose.
So something did change, dear. The card shows the shift plainly.
And look at his hands, dear. One reaching up, one letting go low.
But the reason sits with him, dear, and he hasn't said it out loud.
That's why guessing has taken up your weeks, dear. It's hard work.
Let me look closer at what has opened up between you…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — he hangs from one ankle and the rest of him is loose.
You asked why he's pulling away from you. Your hand went to the card that hangs a thing halfway.
So you're halfway, dear. Not ended, and not held either.
And nobody has cut him down, dear. He just hangs there.
But you're being asked to read a gap with no words in it, dear.
That's why evenings leave you spent, dear. You've translated all day.
Let me look closer at what has been widening this…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the dog is white and small against all that rock.
You asked why he's pulling away from you. Your hand went to the one already in motion.
So he is moving, dear. You saw it before anyone said so.
And he moves off, dear, with bare rock behind him.
But motion is all the card gives, dear. It gives no reason.
That's why you noticed first, dear, and had nobody to tell.
Let me look closer at what has been pushing this apart…
